literal: back to · city wall · borrow · one
natural: fight one last battle with our backs to the walls

meaning.en: To stake everything on one final decisive battle when cornered.
meaning.zh: 在自己城下与敌人决一死战，指在绝境中作最后一搏。

equivalents: stake everything on one final fight

examples.zh: 球队背城借一，决赛中拼尽全力。
examples.en: The team staked everything on one last effort in the final.

examples.zh: 公司已无退路，只能背城借一。
examples.en: With no way back the company could only make a last stand.

story.en: After Qi's defeat, Qi's envoys said that if Jin refused terms, they would 'gather the remaining troops and fight one battle beneath the city wall' (收合余烬，背城借一).
story.zh: 齐国佐曰：“收合余烬，背城借一。”

usage.en: Describes a desperate, all-or-nothing effort; the tone is solemn rather than rash. 借 here means 'rely on' or 'to make a stand'.
usage.zh: 形容孤注一掷的最后一搏，语气庄重而不鲁莽。

natural: trouble arising under one's own arms

meaning.en: Sudden trouble breaking out right beside one, often from one's own people.
meaning.zh: 祸变发生在身边，指突然发生的变故出自内部或近处。

equivalents: a crisis right at one's elbow

examples.zh: 敌军未到，却变生肘腋，内部先乱了。
examples.en: Before the enemy arrived, trouble broke out from within and the camp was in chaos.

examples.zh: 防范外敌的同时，更要提防变生肘腋。
examples.en: While guarding against outside enemies, watch even more for trouble at home.

usage.en: A warning about internal betrayals or revolts. Literary; 肘腋 means elbow and armpit, i.e. very close at hand.
usage.zh: 警示内部叛乱或背叛。书面语；“肘腋”指肘和腋，即身边极近之处。

natural: give widely and relieve the multitude

meaning.en: To give generously and help large numbers of people.
meaning.zh: 广泛地施恩惠，救济大众。

examples.zh: 他一生博施济众，被乡亲称为善人。
examples.en: All his life he gave generously, and the villagers called him a good man.

examples.zh: 基金会致力于博施济众。
examples.en: The foundation is dedicated to helping many people.

story.en: Zigong asked about 'giving widely to the people and helping the multitude'; Confucius said this is beyond humaneness, a sage's work that even Yao and Shun found hard.
story.zh: 子贡曰：“如有博施于民而能济众，何如？可谓仁乎？”子曰：“何事于仁，必也圣乎！尧舜其犹病诸！”

usage.en: Describes great philanthropists or benevolent rulers; Confucius said even Yao and Shun might fail to fully achieve it. Formal and respectful.
usage.zh: 用于大慈善家或仁君；孔子说连尧舜也难完全做到。正式，庄重。

meaning.en: Steady progress day by day and month by month.
meaning.zh: 每天有成就，每月有进步，形容不断进步。

examples.zh: 只要坚持练习，日就月将，必有收获。
examples.en: Keep practising and you will progress steadily and be rewarded.

examples.zh: 孩子的学业日就月将。
examples.en: The child's studies are improving steadily.

story.en: The ode 'Jingzhi' says: 'Day by day I achieve, month by month I advance, learning to shine ever brighter' (日就月将，学有缉熙于光明).
story.zh: 《敬之》：“日就月将，学有缉熙于光明。”

usage.en: Encouraging words for learners; 将 here reads jiāng ('advance'), not jiàng. Literary, often in teachers' or elders' wishes.
usage.zh: 对学习者的鼓励语；“将”读 jiāng，意为进步。书面语，常见于师长祝语。

natural: swallows and sparrows nesting in a hall

meaning.en: To be complacent in peace, unaware of coming danger.
meaning.zh: 燕雀在堂屋里筑巢，不知灾祸将至，比喻处于危险境地而毫无觉察。

examples.zh: 市场格局正在变化，企业不能燕雀处堂。
examples.en: The market is changing, and firms cannot be complacent about the danger.

examples.zh: 大战在即，仍燕雀处堂，岂不危险？
examples.en: With a great battle imminent, to remain so complacent is dangerous.

story.en: Zisi's grandson Zi Shun told Wei's chancellor of swallows and sparrows living in a hall, content, while fire spreads from the chimney and they do not notice.
story.zh: 燕雀处屋，子母相哺，煦煦焉其相乐也，自以为安矣；灶突炎上，栋宇将焚，燕雀颜不变，不知祸之将及己也。

usage.en: A warning against complacency; often paired with 居安思危. Literary and serious.
usage.zh: 警告安于现状；常与“居安思危”并提。书面语，语气严肃。

meaning.en: Peace with nothing amiss.
meaning.zh: 平安稳定，没有变故。

examples.zh: 过年期间，小城太平无事。
examples.en: Over the new year the small town was calm and peaceful.

examples.zh: 但愿一年到头太平无事。
examples.en: I hope the whole year passes without incident.

usage.en: Neutral description of calm times; sometimes ironic when peace is about to be shattered. Compare 平安无事.
usage.zh: 中性，描述安稳时期；有时带反讽，暗示平静将被打破。可比较“平安无事”。

natural: with the passing of years and days

meaning.en: After a long time has passed.
meaning.zh: 时间长久，岁月悠久。

examples.zh: 老房子年深日久，墙皮已经剥落。
examples.en: The old house is of great age and the plaster is peeling.

examples.zh: 年深日久，往事渐渐淡忘了。
examples.en: As years go by, the past is slowly forgotten.

usage.en: Often introduces a result caused by long time; can be used for objects that age or memories that fade. Neutral.
usage.zh: 常引出时间久而产生的结果；可用于物品老化或记忆淡忘。中性。

meaning.en: A master's disciples and their disciples; also followers or hangers-on of a boss, sometimes mockingly.
meaning.zh: 徒弟的徒弟，泛指师门后辈，也指追随者、党羽。

examples.zh: 武林门派的徒子徒孙遍布各地。
examples.en: Disciples and disciples' disciples of the martial school are spread everywhere.

examples.zh: 他和他的徒子徒孙们都来了。
examples.en: He and all his followers have turned up.

usage.en: Often humorous or slightly derogatory when used for supporters of a boss. In martial-arts novels it simply means descendants of a school.
usage.zh: 用于上司的追随者时常带诙谐或贬义；在武侠小说中则指师门后代弟子。

meaning.en: A notorious robber operating over wide areas; a major criminal.
meaning.zh: 在江河湖海一带流窜作案的大盗，指大规模作案的强盗。

examples.zh: 警方抓获了通缉多年的江洋大盗。
examples.en: The police captured the master criminal wanted for many years.

examples.zh: 他以前是个江洋大盗，后来洗手不干了。
examples.en: He was once a notorious bandit, and later gave up crime.

usage.en: Used in crime stories and news-style narratives; also jokingly for a cunning thief. Neutral register with a dramatic flavour.
usage.zh: 用于犯罪故事和新闻式叙述，也可戏称狡猾的窃贼。中性，带戏剧色彩。

meaning.en: The rulers and high officials of history, as a group.
meaning.zh: 历史上的皇帝、国王、将军和宰相，泛指统治阶层人物。

equivalents: the great and mighty of history

examples.zh: 历史课本多讲帝王将相，较少写平民。
examples.en: History textbooks mostly cover rulers and statesmen, less about commoners.

examples.zh: 帝王将相的故事总是引人入胜。
examples.en: Stories of emperors and generals are always gripping.

usage.en: Refers to a social class; 将 reads jiàng ('general'). Often used in contrast with common people (平民百姓) when discussing history's focus.
usage.zh: 指统治阶层；“将”读 jiàng，意为将军。讨论历史视角时常与“平民百姓”对举。

meaning.en: Ancient weapons in general.
meaning.zh: 刀、枪、剑、戟，泛指各种古代兵器。

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着各式刀枪剑戟。
examples.en: The museum displays all kinds of swords, spears and halberds.

examples.zh: 武打片里刀枪剑戟一应俱全。
examples.en: The martial-arts film features every kind of old weapon.

usage.en: A descriptive group term, not a moral statement. Used in stories of warfare and martial arts.
usage.zh: 描述性组合词，不含评价；用于战争和武侠故事。

meaning.en: An army that fights a just cause and treats people well.
meaning.zh: 行仁义、主持正义的军队。

examples.zh: 人民称赞这支部队是仁义之师。
examples.en: The people praised the troops as a just and humane army.

examples.zh: 仁义之师所到之处，百姓箪食壶浆相迎。
examples.en: Wherever the army of righteousness went, the people welcomed it with food and drink.

usage.en: Traditional praise for a disciplined army; also used in political rhetoric. Formal, solemn.
usage.zh: 对纪律严明的军队的传统赞语，也用于政治宣传。正式，庄重。

meaning.en: Completely carried away by an interest, feeling or passion, as if mad.
meaning.zh: 像痴呆又像疯狂一样，形容对人或事物着迷到失去常态。

examples.zh: 球迷们为球队如痴如狂。
examples.en: The fans were mad about their team.

examples.zh: 他对摄影如痴如狂，常常忘记吃饭。
examples.en: He was obsessed with photography and often forgot to eat.

usage.en: Either admiring or gently teasing; refers to intense enthusiasm or infatuation. Often followed by 的状态 or preceded by 为…. Neutral.
usage.zh: 或赞赏或打趣，指极度热爱或着迷。中性。

meaning.en: Romantic love and attachment between men and women.
meaning.zh: 男女之间的爱情和情意。

equivalents: romantic love between a man and a woman

examples.zh: 这部小说写的是普通人的男欢女爱。
examples.en: The novel is about the loves of ordinary people.

examples.zh: 她不想再卷入男欢女爱的是非中。
examples.en: She no longer wanted to be drawn into the gossip of romance.

usage.en: Neutral to slightly risqué in tone; often found in older novels and drama. Sometimes dismissive about trifling love affairs.
usage.zh: 语气中性，略带艳情色彩，常见于旧小说和戏曲。有时轻视儿女私情。

meaning.en: All the disputes, gossip and arguments over who is right and wrong.
meaning.zh: 指各种纷争、议论和对错之争。

examples.zh: 几十年的是是非非，早该放下了。
examples.en: After decades of rights and wrongs, it is time to let go.

examples.zh: 职场里的是是非非，他从不参与。
examples.en: He never gets involved in the gossip and quarrels at work.

usage.en: Describes quarrels and rumours in a community; also 是非曲直 (full details of the right and wrong). Casual, mildly weary.
usage.zh: 描述团体里的纷争和流言；也说“是非曲直”。口语，略带厌倦。

meaning.en: To understand or see something immediately at a glance.
meaning.zh: 一看就明白，形容事情很明显。

examples.zh: 这幅画是赝品，一望而知。
examples.en: The painting is a fake, as can be seen at a glance.

examples.zh: 他的疲惫，一望而知。
examples.en: His fatigue was obvious at a glance.

usage.en: Used for obvious facts or traits that need no explanation. Neutral; often 一望便知.
usage.zh: 用于明显、无需解释的事实或特点。中性；也说“一望便知”。

meaning.en: The mightiest authority imaginable, used to say that nobody can stop one.
meaning.zh: 天上最大的神，比喻最有权势的人，常用于表示谁也不怕。

examples.zh: 今天就是天王老子来了，我也不让。
examples.en: Even if the Heavenly King himself came today, I would not yield.

examples.zh: 他觉得自己是天王老子，谁也管不了。
examples.en: He thinks he is the supreme authority and nobody can control him.

usage.en: Always used in defiant colloquial speech: 就是天王老子也... ; 老子 as a neutral-tone noun (lǎo zi) here is slangy. Rough in tone.
usage.zh: 多用于口语中的强硬表态，如“就是天王老子也……”；“老子”读轻声，较粗俗。

natural: as far apart as heaven and earth

meaning.en: A huge difference between two things.
meaning.zh: 像天地之间的差别那样大，形容差距很大。

equivalents: as different as night and day

examples.zh: 两家公司的待遇天差地远。
examples.en: The pay at the two firms is worlds apart.

examples.zh: 理想和现实天差地远。
examples.en: Ideals and reality are miles apart.

usage.en: A casual, vivid variation of 天壤之别 or 天差地别. Neutral; often used about gaps in quality or standard.
usage.zh: 口语，是“天壤之别”“天差地别”的生动说法。中性，多用于质量、水平的差距。

meaning.en: Someone who rushes about aimlessly, without a plan.
meaning.zh: 没有头的苍蝇到处乱撞，比喻做事没有方向，乱闯乱撞。

examples.zh: 别像没头苍蝇一样乱撞，先理清思路。
examples.en: Don't dash about like a headless chicken; sort out your thoughts first.

examples.zh: 发现问题后，大家成了没头苍蝇。
examples.en: When the problem was discovered everyone ran around like headless flies.

usage.en: Usually 像没头苍蝇一样 or 没头苍蝇似的, in colloquial criticism. 没头苍蝇 is commonly a guanyongyu rather than a classical idiom.
usage.zh: 常说“像没头苍蝇一样”“没头苍蝇似的”，口语批评。更接近惯用语而非成语。

meaning.en: A gifted and romantic young man, often a poet with many admirers.
meaning.zh: 风度潇洒、才华出众的男子，多指富有诗才和浪漫气质的人。

examples.zh: 唐伯虎被称为江南第一风流才子。
examples.en: Tang Bohu was called the foremost dashing talent of the south.

examples.zh: 他年轻时是校园里的风流才子。
examples.en: In his youth he was the dashing talent of the campus.

usage.en: Usually praise with a hint of playfulness about romantic exploits; also teasing or mild criticism. Often in the pairing with 倾城佳人.
usage.zh: 多为赞语，略带对风流韵事的调侃，也可作打趣或轻微批评。常与“倾国佳人”对举。

meaning.en: Playing wind and percussion instruments; the lively sound of a wedding or celebration.
meaning.zh: 吹奏和敲打乐器，形容热闹的喜庆场面。

equivalents: with a band of pipes and drums

examples.zh: 迎亲的队伍吹吹打打，一路热闹。
examples.en: The wedding procession went along with pipes and drums, full of life.

examples.zh: 村里吹吹打打，是在办喜事。
examples.en: The village was ringing with music because of a celebration.

usage.en: Describes a festive din of weddings, funerals or parades; neutral, humorous when overdone.
usage.zh: 形容婚礼、葬礼或游行时的热闹乐声；中性，过度喧闹时带幽默。

meaning.en: The second-highest position, subordinate only to the top; often 一人之下，万人之上.
meaning.zh: 处于一个人之下的地位，指仅次于最高统治者的高位。

examples.zh: 他官拜宰相，一人之下，万人之上。
examples.en: He became chancellor, second only to the emperor and above all others.

examples.zh: 在这家公司，他是一人之下的实权人物。
examples.en: In this company he is the real power, second only to the boss.

usage.en: Almost always in the full set 一人之下，万人之上. Describes a chancellor or deputy. Neutral, with a sense of high rank.
usage.zh: 几乎总是整句“一人之下，万人之上”，指宰相或副手。中性，含地位崇高之意。

meaning.en: Somewhat used but not yet worn out.
meaning.zh: 不太新也不太旧，指东西用过但还不算破旧。

examples.zh: 他穿着一件半新不旧的外套。
examples.en: He wore a coat that was neither new nor old.

examples.zh: 半新不旧的家具，卖不上好价钱。
examples.en: Furniture that is neither new nor old will not fetch a good price.

usage.en: Describes objects such as clothes and furniture; neutral to mildly deprecating.
usage.zh: 描述衣服、家具等物品；中性略带贬义。

meaning.en: Daoist ideal: remain calm and do not interfere, letting things follow their nature.
meaning.zh: 道家主张的清净安定、顺其自然、不妄为的态度。

examples.zh: 他提倡清静无为的治国方略。
examples.en: He advocated a way of governing through quietness and non-interference.

examples.zh: 晚年他追求清静无为的生活。
examples.en: In his later years he pursued a life of quiet and non-striving.

usage.en: A Daoist political and personal ideal; can sound approving or derogatory (laziness) depending on stance. Literary.
usage.zh: 道家的政治和人生理想；视立场可褒可贬（有时被批评为消极）。书面语。

meaning.en: To burst into loud weeping.
meaning.zh: 放声大哭，悲痛地大声哭泣。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她大放悲声。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news she burst into loud sobs.

examples.zh: 全场不禁大放悲声。
examples.en: Everyone present could not help weeping aloud.

usage.en: Used in narrative about intense grief; formal-literary. Usually after 听到/见到 + sad news.
usage.zh: 用于叙述极度悲痛；书面语，常接在听到、见到噩耗之后。
